accepted.quote: While we strongly support expanding educational access for our nation's veterans, we have concerns with some unintended consequences that H.R. 1458 may cause as currently drafted.
accepted.rationale: Takano states strong support for expanding educational access for veterans while raising concerns about the bill as drafted.

accepted.quote: Without strong and enforceable guardrails, the Department of Veterans Affairs will struggle to prevent waste, fraud, and abuse--at the expense of the very veterans we aim to serve.
accepted.rationale: Takano calls for strong enforceable guardrails so VA can prevent waste, fraud, and abuse in GI Bill programs.
